rows.definition: The raw candidate extraction operation of compute.SamplingCandidateBackend (internal/compute/sampling_candidates.go): given a full F32 logit row and k, the producer inspects the entire row on device and writes the global k+1 maxima with their original token IDs and raw float32 payloads into a caller-owned packet. Implemented by *cudaBackend under the cuda build tag (cuda_sampling_candidates.go), which refuses quantized, capturing, or non-F32 rows and returns available=false without error when capability or state cannot admit the work. No probability or RNG calculation belongs in the producer.
rows.distinction: The backend-side EXTRACTION primitive over one logit row; not StepSamplingCandidates (the session-level step that drives one decode step through this backend and falls back to full logits), not deviceSamplingCandidates (the agent-lane gate deciding whether compact transport is used at all), and not SamplingCandidatePacket (the storage the result lands in).

rows.definition: A constant equal to 64 in internal/compute/sampling_candidates.go that bounds host transport for compact sampling candidates, not the vocabulary on the device. It sizes the fixed ID/Raw arrays of SamplingCandidatePacket (MaxK+1 entries) and is the upper bound on k accepted by SamplingCandidateBackend.SamplingCandidates, Session.StepSamplingCandidates, and Certify.
rows.distinction: A transport-size bound on how many candidate slots cross from device to host; not a caller-chosen sampler top-k (which merely must fall within [1, MaxK]), not a vocabulary size, and not a CUDA workspace limit.

rows.definition: A caller-owned scratch struct in internal/compute holding a compact raw logit row: Vocab, Count, and Valid flags plus fixed [65]int IDs and [65]float32 Raw arrays, and a pointer-free nativeWords uint32 staging buffer that keeps the lane free of per-token CGo buffers. The device producer fills it with the global k+1 maxima; Certify(temp, k) validates it, insertion-sorts it, trims it to k, and converts it to the host sampler's compact row.
rows.distinction: The STORAGE container for raw candidates; not the extraction operation that fills it (SamplingCandidates), not the session step that produces it (StepSamplingCandidates), and not the final sampled token - the draw stays with the caller.

rows.definition: An optional interface in internal/compute declaring the single method SamplingCandidates(row Tensor, k int, retain bool, out *SamplingCandidatePacket) (kept Tensor, available bool, err error). model.Session type-asserts s.Backend to it before attempting compact extraction, and *cudaBackend implements it under the cuda build tag. A false available result is legal only before candidate work is submitted, and failure is never a numeric fallback.
rows.distinction: A CAPABILITY interface over a compute backend; not a concrete backend (*cudaBackend), not the packet it fills (SamplingCandidatePacket), and not the session call site (StepSamplingCandidates).

rows.definition: A method on model.Session (internal/model/hal_sampling_candidates.go) that advances exactly once through the ordinary Step lifecycle while attempting compact candidate extraction. On acceptance the packet holds a compact raw row and it returns compact=true with full=nil; otherwise it falls back to the ordinary full logits readback, and a numeric or capability refusal is never a second model step. The draw remains with the caller.
rows.distinction: The SESSION-level driver of one decode step; not the backend extraction primitive (SamplingCandidates), not the agent-lane eligibility gate (deviceSamplingCandidates), and not the ordinary Step path, which always returns full logits.

rows.definition: A method on agent.decodeLane (internal/agent/inkernel_sampling_candidates.go) reporting whether this serial decode lane may use compact device-side candidate transport: FAK_CUDA_SAMPLING_COMPACT=1, finite temp>0, topK within [1, SamplingCandidateMaxK] and below the vocab size, no logit bias or frequency/presence penalties, and no engram-attempt or structured-output interference. When true the lane routes its next step through stepSamplingCandidates into Session.StepSamplingCandidates. It changes transport only, never the RNG or sampler implementation.
rows.distinction: The AGENT-LANE eligibility gate (env opt-in plus lane state); not the session step (StepSamplingCandidates), not the backend primitive (SamplingCandidates), and not a performance claim - source presence does not performance-qualify it.

rows.definition: A local TPPlan value built in Model.ForwardTP via NewTPPlan(cfg.NumKVHeads, clampRanks(tp.AttnRanks, cfg.NumKVHeads)) at internal/model/tensor_parallel_forward.go:569: it tiles the KV-head dimension into near-even contiguous shards that drive the column-parallel Q/K/V and row-parallel output projection across attention ranks. It is passed to tpAttnLayer and forwardTPSP for every layer.
rows.distinction: The tensor-parallel plan over the ATTENTION head axis (NumKVHeads); not ffnPlan (tiles IntermediateSize for the MLP), not spPlan (tiles the sequence dimension for sequence parallelism), and not the generic TPPlan type or the vocab-axis plan (tpVocabPlan).

rows.definition: A local TPPlan value built in Model.ForwardTP via NewTPPlan(cfg.IntermediateSize, clampRanks(tp.FFNRanks, cfg.IntermediateSize)) at internal/model/tensor_parallel_forward.go:573: it tiles the FFN intermediate dimension into contiguous shards for the column/row-parallel MLP matmul across FFN ranks. Consumed by tpFFNLayer and forwardTPSP.
rows.distinction: The tensor-parallel plan over the FFN INTERMEDIATE axis (IntermediateSize); not attnPlan (tiles KV heads for attention), not spPlan (tiles the sequence dimension), and not the vocab-axis plan (tpVocabPlan).

rows.definition: A local TPPlan value built in Model.ForwardTP only when sequence parallelism is armed (clampRanks(tp.SequenceRanks, seq) > 1): NewTPPlan(seq, spRanks) tiles the SEQUENCE dimension so the residual stream is sharded along the sequence axis outside the TP cores. forwardTPSP, spSublayer, spSliceBands, and spGatherBands in tensor_parallel_sequence.go consume it. SP here means sequence parallelism, not single-pass.
rows.distinction: The outer SEQUENCE-DIMENSION plan wrapping the TP cores; not attnPlan (KV-head tiling inside attention), not ffnPlan (intermediate tiling inside the MLP), and not a single-pass flag.

rows.definition: A method on gateway.memberWorker (internal/gateway/replica_ejection.go) reporting whether a worker may be admitted when no holder of a model is admissible: unhealthy on evidence but not draining. FleetMembership.classifyForModelLocked collects such workers into a failOpen list and, when zero admissible holders survive, returns them instead of ErrNoHealthyWorker - a degraded answer beats a guaranteed outage. Draining and never-probed workers are never resurrected.
rows.distinction: A per-worker FAIL-OPEN ADMISSIBILITY predicate in fleet placement; not the ejection window machinery (ejectLocked/ejectedLocked), not the admissible-holder fast path (CandidatesForModel), and not the health probe loop (RunHealthLoop).
